The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/google-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-explained-digital-14|COREMERCH guide to google]] Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Online gumroad

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to a set of tools and technologies that allow digital creators to sell their products directly to consumers while maintaining full control over their data and transactions. Unlike platforms such as Gumroad and Stripe, which limit access based on geographic location, sovereign infrastructure provides a permissionless solution. This matters because it enables creators in restricted countries to reach global audiences without the barriers imposed by traditional payment processors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure is built on readily available technologies that work together seamlessly. For example, using Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing allows creators to set up their stores quickly and efficiently. By leveraging tools like Supabase for order management and Google Drive for file delivery, creators can deliver products instantly without relying on third-party platforms. This decentralized approach ensures that the creator maintains ownership and control over their entire sales process.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors fail to provide service, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. It empowers artists, educators, and entrepreneurs to sell their ebooks, courses, and other digital products without the constraints of geographic limitations. By using sovereign commerce infrastructure, these creators can avoid the risk of account suspensions that often come with platforms like PayPal, which can hold funds for up to 180 days without recourse.
Freedom from platform restrictions empowers creators to sell without barriers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of this infrastructure lies in its components: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. Each component is designed to be lightweight and easy to implement, allowing quick deployment of an online store. The integration of these tools creates a robust ecosystem that supports various digital products while ensuring that creators own their data and can avoid subscription fees and platform restrictions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign commerce stack, start by selecting your preferred hosting service, such as Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage the logic of your sales. Integrate NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring low fees and immediate confirmation. Populate your store with your digital products, and configure file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, ensure your store is live, and promote it to your audience for immediate sales.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, you can still sell digital products by using sovereign commerce infrastructure. This approach leverages tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, enabling you to process payments in crypto and maintain full ownership of your store. This method allows creators in restricted regions to monetize their work effectively.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures you own your data and sales process.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
